title: Joe Marcello at the Hickory House and trying to recall a record's players
summary: Brief talk about Marcello and the Hickory House, then a stretch of garbled audio.

blocks.x: Did you know Joe Marcello around New York? Marcello, yeah. Oh yeah, I knew him.
Oh yeah. He worked in the Hickory House for a long time. Common master played guitar with him for a good while.

Oh yeah. When the Hickory House was going pretty big you know, on 52nd feet. Who sings and music goes round and round? I'm trying to think of who it was. There's two guys that sounded like they were. You know they're jumping away at each other. Yeah. Didn't the trombone player sing? I thought he did this. And who was the trumpet player on that group that made the, do you know who the trumpet player
is? If I hear the name I might know it. I can't think of the music. I can't think of the music.
